task: Generate and evaluate morphology-first Starlight robot silhouette boards across fourteen form families.
surface: Character-system pre-production for Starlight .ai, .org, Academy, marketplace, runtime maps, and spatial experiences.
audience: Founders, operators, developers, researchers, creators, and Academy learners.
first_read: A coherent constellation of original robot forms whose roles are legible through silhouette and function before face, color, or rendering style.

references.label: Founder-approved stronger structural baseline
references.reason: Phase A varied face architecture and is the continuity benchmark for meaningful structural diversity.

avoid: toy or infant coding for adult specialists
polish used to hide weak form
direction.signature: A constellation of functional, emotionally legible machine forms connected by restrained Starlight geometry.
system: one image-generation call per distinct form family
founder selection before face, materials, or cinematic polish
deterministic role metadata remains outside generated pixels

asset_quality.why_premium: The study isolates morphology, uses a role-led prompt and explicit franchise-avoidance constraints, preserves exact receipts and hashes, and requires founder approval before polish.

artifacts.notes: Four meaningfully different compact chassis at 1536x1024. Strong improvement in body diversity versus rejected Phase C; generated component seams are too detailed for a strict silhouette gate and should be reduced in the next pass.
Fourteen separate form-family prompts are queued; no batch prompt conflates distinct assets.
Verbatim prompt receipt for the completed M02 board.
Four role-distinct grayscale maquettes. The observatory candidate is too tall for the stated chibi range; the set is useful comparison evidence, not a final family.
Four strongly differentiated non-humanoid structures with dry engineered materials and visible support logic. Candidate three needs a generic biomimetic-sculpture check.
Prompt and founder-provided construction-quality reference are recorded.
Prompt and founder-provided construction-quality reference are recorded.

Fourteen separate 1536x1024 boards, at least 56 candidates, fourteen exact prompt receipts, and SHA-256 verification in generation-manifest.v1.json. M04, M05, M07, M09, and M14 are strongest; M08 is restart-only negative evidence.
A separate critic inspected all fourteen original-resolution boards, scored the study 20/30, kept only M04 and M14 as directions, and identified six restart families.
Records all board scores, keep/iterate/restart verdicts, candidate seeds, surface policy, and the required 96-pixel comparison gate without claiming production approval.
Binds future images to stable agent identity, specialty, artifact, working behavior, authority boundary, morphology seed, mechanical proof, provenance, and the 30-point surface gate.

checks.name: morphology-before-style
checks.evidence: The completed board varies chassis, torso, stance, tool storage, and proportion while withholding eyes and color.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: The 1536x1024 PNG was visually inspected and hashed after copying into the project.

checks.name: strict-silhouette-restraint
checks.evidence: After founder feedback favored the earlier high-craft direction, the resumed study used two-tone grayscale maquettes with thumbnail silhouette checks instead of flat cut-paper output.

checks.name: founder-approval
checks.evidence: Frank authorized generating all declared families, but has not selected or approved any candidate for production.

checks.name: family-completeness-and-integrity
checks.evidence: All fourteen declared boards and fourteen prompt receipts exist; every PNG is 1536x1024 and matches the SHA-256 digest recorded in generation-manifest.v1.json.

checks.name: restart-discipline
checks.evidence: Independent review marks M01, M06, M08, M10, M11, and M13 for restart while preserving only specific seeds.

checks.name: independent-critique
checks.evidence: A separate visual critic inspected all fourteen original-resolution boards and recorded per-family keep, iterate, and restart verdicts in INDEPENDENT_CRITIQUE.md.

checks.name: machine-performance
checks.evidence: The 2026-08-28 swarm preflight returned ALLOW with 10823 MB free RAM and a two-process ceiling; the image loop remains single-threaded.

score.notes: Independent study-level score. The set has valuable seeds but fails the strict silhouette gate: thirteen boards are grayscale renders, real 96-pixel and UI tests are missing, and several families retain generic robot, surveillance, node, or generated-text artifacts.

best_resumable_next_step: Complete independent visual critique, then test M04, M05, M07, M09, and M14 plus one compact/chibi candidate at 96 pixels and inside real .ai, .org, Academy, marketplace, and graph surfaces before any individual-agent portrait fanout.
